title: Africa’s Fintechs Are Becoming Banks — And That Changes Everything
standfirst: Payments built the distribution. Banking licences, deposits and credit are becoming the next battleground. From Flutterwave and Paystack to Moniepoint, Tyme and MTN, Africa’s financial-services race is moving deeper into the balance sheet.
seo_title: Africa’s Fintechs Are Becoming Banks — The Next Financial Battle
seo_description: Waithaka Ndegwa examines Flutterwave, Paystack, Moniepoint, Tyme and MTN as African fintech moves beyond payments into deposits, lending and regulated banking.
